chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Mithamī from Ya'qub ibn Shu'ayb from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
When Allah, Mighty and Majestic, commanded these verses to descend to the earth, they clung to the Throne and said: 'O Lord, to where are You causing us to descend? To the people of errors and sins?'

So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, revealed to them to descend: 'By My Might and My Majesty! No one from the Progeny of Muhammad and their Shias will recite you at the end of what I have imposed upon him from the prescribed [prayers] in every day, except that I will look at him with My Hidden Eye in every day with seventy glances, fulfilling for him in every glance seventy needs, and accepting him despite whatever he is in from disobediences.'
And these are: the Mother of the Book, and the Verse of the Throne, and the Verse of Dominion.

key_terms.أُمُّ الْكِتَابِ: The Mother of the Book (Surah Al-Fatiha)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit for the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers when reciting specific Quranic verses after daily prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the metaphysical reverence of Quranic verses, personifying them as hesitant to descend among sinners until God guarantees their special protection for the Ahl al-Bayt and their Shias. It establishes a unique spiritual mechanism where reciting these specific verses after obligatory prayers triggers seventy divine glances, each fulfilling a need, thereby ensuring acceptance despite lingering sins. This underscores the Shia theological emphasis on the intercessory and purifying power of the Quran through the lens of the Imams' lineage.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan Al Maysami, from Yaqoub Bin Shuayb, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Commanded these Verses that they should descend to the earth, they attached themselves to the Throne and they said: ‘Yes Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! To where are You<sup>azwj</sup> Causing us to descend to? The people of the errors and sins?’

So Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Revealed unto them to descend: “By Myazwj Might and Myazwj Majesty! You will not be recited by anyone from the Progenyasws of Muhammadsaww and theirasws Shias at the end of what Iazwj have Imposed upon him from the Prescribed (Salāt) during every day, except that Iazwj would Look at him with Myazwj Hidden Eyes during every day with seventy Glances, Fulfilling for him during every Glance, seventy needs, and Accept him upon whatever he would be in, from disobeying Meazwj.

And these are – the Mother of the Book (Surah Al-Fatiha – Chapter 1), [3:18] Allah bears witness that there is no god but He, and (so do) the Angels and those possessed of knowledge, and the Ayat Al-Kursy [2:255]’.
en.sarwar: 2. Hamid ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan al-Maythami from Ya’qub ibn Shu’ayb from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “

When Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, commanded certain verses of the Holy Quran to descend to earth, they clung to the Throne asking, ‘O Lord, why are You sending us to people of sins and evil deeds.’

Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, inspired them to descend saying, ‘I swear by My Majesty and Glory that any Shi’a (followers) of Ahl al-Bciyt (family of Muhammad, recipients of divine supreme covenant), who reads you after an obligatory prayer every day I will look at him with My hidden eyes (special favor) everyday seventy times and in every look fulfill his seventy wishes and accept him with whatever sins he may have.
The verses are Chapter One of the Holy Quran, verses 18-19 and 26-27 of Chapter 3 and verse 255 of Chapter 2 of the Holy Quran.’”
